requirements.summary: Implementation of Nordwerk Industrie-Service static B2B website Release Candidate 1 (RC1) in index.html conforming to issue_t3.md specifications.
acceptance_criteria: HTML structure conforms to HTML5 with lang="de", <meta charset="UTF-8">, and links to styles.css via <link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css">.
Document uses semantic HTML5 tags including <header>, <nav>, <main>, <h1>, <section>, and <footer>.
Contains exact brand name 'Nordwerk Industrie-Service' (N-01) and hero claim 'Praktische Unterstützung für Ihren technischen Betrieb.' (N-02).
Contains service description 'Wartungsplanung: Wir strukturieren Wartungsaufgaben und dokumentieren Zuständigkeiten für kleine technische Betriebe.' (N-03).
Contains primary call-to-action link with exact text 'Anfrage stellen' and href='mailto:kontakt@nordwerk.example' (N-08).
Footer contains the exact legal project disclaimer: 'Fiktives Unternehmen – Lehrprojekt der HAW Hamburg. Keine realen Angebote oder Kontaktaufnahme.' (N-09).
No external links (http:// or https://), external CDN assets/fonts, or tracking scripts (google-analytics, gtag) are present.
No unapproved marketing claims or fake certifications (such as ISO 9001, TÜV, or 24/7 Notdienst) are included.
All automated test suites in test_website.py pass when running a local HTTP server.

architecture.summary: The file is currently an empty placeholder boilerplate containing TODOs and lacks core architectural layout and semantic structure.
findings: Missing semantic structure: Key landmark elements such as <header>, <nav>, <main>, and <footer> are absent.
Placeholder metadata: The <title> element still contains 'TODO: Website Setup' and lacks descriptive SEO/meta tags.
Incomplete implementation: The <body> tag only contains a placeholder paragraph for TASK-001 with no functional layout or component contracts.

delivery_risks: Exact verbatim copy requirements (N-01, N-02, N-03, N-08, N-09) may fail automated test regex/equality checks due to whitespace or typographic dash mismatches.
Accidental inclusion of external font links, script CDNs, or absolute HTTP/HTTPS URLs violating AC-05 zero-external-dependency rule.
Omission of required semantic HTML5 container elements (<nav>, <main>, <section>, <footer>, <header>) breaking DOM validation checks.
